target_label: iKant_LE v1.0 experimental — physical E2E closure profile (analysis target; not npm/package version)

entities.name: HostBootstrapBindingReceipt
entities.meaning: Host-observed proof that the host callable invoked the existing canonical bootstrap owner and the owner returned OWNER_NEXT; source is pinned and receipt fresh. Reading or predicting code is not execution.

entities.name: RuntimeExecutionReceipt
entities.meaning: Runtime-owned proof that exact pinned runtime-root bytes were materialized, reopened, and actually executed as one concrete runtime instance. RUNTIME_BOUND_LIMITED is sufficient; legacy ACTIVE is not required.

entities.name: CohostRelationAttestation
entities.meaning: Sealed owner-produced attestation recomputed from B0/R0/R1/R2 proof references. Caller-authored cohostStatus is not proof.

entities.name: HostRouteInterpositionReceipt
entities.meaning: Host-observed proof that this turn was offered to the canonical runtime route under active interposition, with no bypass, no unresolved prior turn, and synchronized route/transcript ordinal.

entities.name: NativeParticipantLease
entities.meaning: Persistent native non-user participant identity with current/future standing, persistent scheduler relationship, fresh lease, and no per-message manual reselection.

entities.name: NativeTurnGrantReceipt
entities.meaning: Turn-specific host-scheduler proof that the E4 participant was actually granted this turn. A free-standing turn_lease_id string is insufficient.

entities.name: NativeDeliveryReadbackReceipt
entities.meaning: Host-observed native transcript publication under the E4 participant, bound to E5 grant, with exact runtime-output bytes and host readback.

laws.name: OwnerProvenanceAndSeal
laws.meaning: Every proof-bearing entity is emitted/observed by its declared owner, externally observed where required, sealed/content-addressed, and never accepted as raw caller-authored status.

laws.name: ExactCrossBindingAndFreshness
laws.meaning: All entities bind the same host session, source head, runtime root/instance, participant and turn where applicable; stale, replayed, cross-session or cross-turn evidence fails.

laws.name: FailClosedProjection
laws.meaning: Earliest missing/invalid physical edge declassifies deterministically: bootstrap -> INTEGRATION_IMPEDIMENT; runtime/cohost -> NOT_READY; route -> SESSION_ROUTE_BLOCKED; native proof -> COHOST_RELATION_ONLY. No invented environment blocker and no later evidence washes out an earlier gap.

laws.name: SurrogateRejection
laws.meaning: App/panel/widget, assistant prefix, forged status, manual selection, FULL_RUNTIME, control ownership, CANONICAL_PRODUCT or legacy ACTIVE cannot substitute physical host receipts.

laws.name: AxisOrthogonality
laws.meaning: Relation, runtime capability, product canonicality, control ownership and native participation remain separate axes; stronger unrelated states are neither necessary nor sufficient for native E2E.
